column1: Materials refers to the number of cards in hand or on field that can be used for the combo
generally a card on field or in hand is worth 1 material, but there are some exceptions:
3) Foolish/FuFu send dandy is worth 2 cards
4) Foolish/FuFu send fishborg is worth 0 cards (if used)
6) Fishborg is worth 0 cards in hand if you have to swap pitch it into gy
Extra deck monsters require a certain number of materials, which vary based on whether you have beelze or des frog in deck
The rest of this sheet uses potential otk situations into an open board, and estimates the number of cards cost using the estimates above.
While these otks are useful, they are not the entire game, and often you will have to adapt endboards to the situation, or conditions that have arrisen during it.
